text:
sara: quick follow-up on RFC: customers want to pin fp8 at tenant level for cost, but ops needs safe automatic fallback to int8/4bit on quality regressions. how do we express this without a monster config?

kevin: idea: compact policy object referenced by routes. policy = ordered variants + small safety_gates set (deg_threshold, latency_ms, canary_rate). runtime picks highest-ranked variant that passes gates.

leo: add cache_compat boolean. if false -> flush KV prefix on switch; if true -> allow hot switch. default false to be safe.

priya: who owns degscore? ops wants per-tenant normalization. add quality_signal_namespace so baselines can be tenant-scoped.

kevin: sketch: route has precision_policy_id. policy contains variant_list, safety_gates, cache_compat, quality_namespace, allow_per_call.

ops-bot: scheduled sample-run for tenant_foo to measure cache-flush penalty at 2026-04-04T07:00Z. results to /eng-ml/precision-observability.

sara: rollback semantics: don't migrate in-flight requests; new requests follow new variant. reduces partial-response weirdness.

leo: defaults: conservative quality-first policy plus an "aggressive-cost" preset. enterprise consent required for any policy that may change semantics.

priya: ops playbook action: notify customer on auto-rollbacks, provide opt-out, include legal signoff for enterprise.

kevin: delivery plan: API add precision_policy_id, DB store versioned policy, runtime evaluate gates & cache_compat, observability emit precision_decision events.

sara: action items: leo draft schema (due EOD), kevin toy harness prototype (next Tue), priya ops playbook (next Wed), ops-bot run sampling job (ETA today).

priya: agree to nightly shadowing of fp8 to compute deltas vs baseline before enabling customer opt-ins.

leo: question: per-call header? dangerous. allow only if policy.allow_per_call is true and with audit logs.

sara: ok thanks, team :rocket:
